newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Libya '96 currency revenues $9.573 billion - CB Governor.
newsitem.headline: Libya '96 currency revenues $9.573 billion - CB Governor.

text.p: Libya's revenues in foreign currencies amounted to $9.573 billion in 1996, Libyan Central Bank Governor Tahar Jehim said.

The overall balance of payments showed a surplus of $680 million in addition to the annual one billion dollars special saving, and a rise in the country's gold stock by 4.5 tonnes, he told the General People's Congress, Libya's equivalent of parliament during a session that ended on Sunday.
The debates were broadcast live by the state-run Libyan television monitored over the week end in Tunis.
